name: @post/e2e-search
description: Search Answer e2e (T0907): real Chromium drives the built web app through /search — the answered / fallback (all six reasons) / loading / error states, the cited sources checked by ref against the document, the URL as the question's only address, a source click landing on the address the answer gave, and the absence of any section the answer did not fill — against mock-api.mjs, a real HTTP origin serving the exact wire shape cmd/api/searchhttp + internal/search/answer answer produce (the answer is read by a credentialed POST from the browser, and a source's href is a second document, so the harness is an origin rather than a route handler).
